summary: Created software, simulation, cloud, and embedded foundations for an R&D exoskeleton platform.
highlights: Developed ROS 1 and ROS 2 packages and collected real-time R&D data.
Designed exoskeleton-to-cloud architecture with AI and machine-learning components.
Built simulations, calibrated sensors, and worked with STM32, Raspberry Pi, and BeagleBone platforms.
